name: hrow5_hub-n1-0030-COMMIT
purpose: S-ELEM-PQ/HROW 2026-10-16: closed hrow5_hub-r5d-1a91bcdd1 fails the native pin audit (R 236.3, spread 45.0, TT launch 316.0 on 202 outputs e.g. t_rc1[3], capture 357.3 on 2436 of 3180 inputs e.g. f_pr1[693]; results/physical/s81_hrow_native_0030/native_audit_s81_hc_hrow_0030.json). Cause: inhold/outhold pads but the RTL pin flops float into the core and synthesis merges the three rcq[p] read-command copies. Fix: recipe 3 kit (io_flop_at_pins + pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs + HB2 pads); RTL, outline, pin faces unchanged; 0 cycles added (every port already registered in RTL; pin_regs wrapper opted out with reason). Pass: TT/FF >= 0, DRC 0, native launch <= 220 / capture <= 190 / spread <= 80, hrow_tiles pos PASS / mut FAIL.
